flagged.title: Presenting & Analysing Fieldwork
flagged.reason: The video states both visually and aloud that the slope of a line of best fit reveals the strength of the relationship, which is a known GCSE correlation misconception that loses marks in an analysis question.

mark_affecting.quote: The slope of this line instantly reveals the strength of the relationship between your variables.

flagged.title: Conclusions, Evaluation & UK Decisions
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly advises students that using a metre rule instead of a tape measure is a top-mark improvement to reduce tape stretch, which is an invalid methodology that would lose marks in an exam evaluation question.

mark_affecting.quote: A strong, maximum mark improvement is saying something like: use a metre rule rather than a tape measure to completely reduce stretch error.
